description: This file declares functions and structures related to managing block sources in a reftable system, including reading data, closing resources, and creating in-memory sources.

methods.name: block_source_close
methods.description: Closes the block source and underlying resources.

methods.name: block_source_read_data
methods.description: Reads a block of data from the source at a given offset.

methods.name: block_source_size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the resource.

methods.name: block_source_release_data
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a data block.

methods.name: block_source_from_buf
methods.description: Creates an in-memory block source from a buffer.
